notes: Three verified S-tier Keystone Korner Baltimore discoveries absent from the canonical RADAR on 2026-08-18. Selected for unusually strong instrumental identity, active project context, groove/improvisational focus, and intimate-room value rather than name recognition alone.

events.factual_description: Keystone Korner Baltimore presents Simon Phillips & Protocol 6 on Wednesday and Thursday, August 19-20, 2026, at 7:00 PM. The authorized InstantSeats event page lists Phillips on drums with Phillip Whack, Alex Sill, Otmaro Ruiz and Ernest Tibbs, and describes Protocol 6 as the 2026 culmination of Phillips's long-running original jazz-rock project.

sources.note: Official venue calendar confirms August 19-20 and 7:00 PM performances.
Authorized exact event page confirms first date, showtime, venue, lineup and Protocol 6 project context; live venue listing also exposes the August 20 performance.
Official artist schedule corroborates the Protocol 6 US Tour and both Baltimore dates.
Exact album page for Protocol 6, released June 5, 2026.

provenance.note: Dates and showtime verified against Keystone Korner Baltimore and authorized InstantSeats; lineup and event concept verified from the exact authorized event page and corroborated by Simon Phillips's official tour schedule.

en.why_it_matters: This is not a legacy-drummer cameo. Protocol is Phillips's own compositional language, and Protocol 6 puts his precision and power inside a current fusion band built on guitar, keys, saxophone and bass. In Keystone Korner's small room, the tension between jazz improvisation, progressive detail and genuinely heavy rock/funk groove should be unusually physical.
en.trip_verdict: S regional/local. Protect August 19 or 20 and make the Baltimore drive if drums, fusion and progressive instrumental music are the draw; it is not a destination trip by itself.

es.why_it_matters: No es una aparición nostálgica de un baterista famoso. Protocol es el lenguaje compositivo propio de Phillips, y Protocol 6 pone su precisión y potencia dentro de una banda actual de fusión con guitarra, teclados, saxofón y bajo. En la escala pequeña de Keystone Korner, la tensión entre improvisación jazzística, detalle progresivo y groove pesado de rock/funk debería sentirse con una fuerza muy física.
es.trip_verdict: S regional/local. Hay que proteger el 19 o el 20 de agosto y vale manejar a Baltimore si el atractivo son batería, fusión y música instrumental progresiva; no es por sí solo un viaje destino.

events.artist: Kenny Garrett and Sounds From The Ancestors
events.category: Living masters / Saxophone / Groove / Afro-diasporic jazz
events.factual_description: Keystone Korner Baltimore and its authorized InstantSeats listing present Kenny Garrett and Sounds From The Ancestors for Friday and Saturday, September 11-12, 2026, with 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM sets each night. The event page identifies Garrett as a 2023 NEA Jazz Master and frames the project around the Detroit jazz, R&B and gospel roots and Afro-Caribbean rhythmic vocabulary of Sounds From The Ancestors.

sources.note: Authorized venue listing confirms September 11-12 and four live sets at 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM.
Exact authorized event page verifies Garrett, two-night project context, NEA Jazz Master status, and the Detroit/Afro-Caribbean musical framing.
Exact album page for Sounds from the Ancestors.

provenance.note: Dates, four set times, venue and project description verified against Keystone Korner Baltimore's authorized InstantSeats pages; only Kenny Garrett is included in lineup because the current exact event page does not publish the remaining personnel.

en.why_it_matters: Garrett is already a living-master saxophone case, but the named Sounds From The Ancestors context is the reason this rises above a routine club date. The project folds Detroit jazz, R&B and gospel into Afro-Caribbean rhythmic language, giving Garrett's hard-edged alto sound a groove-heavy, polyrhythmic frame rather than a generic standards set.
en.trip_verdict: S regional/local. Protect one of the four sets; this is strong enough to justify the DMV-to-Baltimore drive for saxophone, groove and a living master in a very small room.

es.why_it_matters: Garrett ya es un caso claro de maestro vivo del saxofón, pero el contexto explícito de Sounds From The Ancestors es lo que eleva esto por encima de una fecha rutinaria de club. El proyecto cruza jazz, R&B y gospel de Detroit con vocabulario rítmico afrocaribeño, poniendo su sonido de alto filoso dentro de un marco polirrítmico y cargado de groove, no en un set genérico de standards.
es.trip_verdict: S regional/local. Hay que proteger uno de los cuatro sets; sí justifica el trayecto DMV-Baltimore por saxofón, groove y un maestro vivo en una sala muy pequeña.

events.subtitle: Sketches of Miles
events.category: Contemporary masters / Miles Davis centennial / Acoustic jazz
events.factual_description: Keystone Korner Baltimore presents ARTEMIS: Sketches of Miles on Friday and Saturday, December 11-12, 2026, with 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM sets each night. The venue bills the current quintet of Renee Rosnes, Ingrid Jensen, Nicole Glover, Noriko Ueda and Allison Miller and identifies ARTEMIS as DownBeat Readers Poll Jazz Group of the Year for 2023, 2024 and 2025.

sources.note: Official venue calendar confirms the Sketches of Miles billing, current five-member lineup, December 11-12 dates and 6:00 PM / 8:30 PM sets.
Exact authorized purchase page confirms Friday, December 11 at 6:00 PM; live venue listing exposes all four performance purchase paths.
Official band site confirms the current quintet and third consecutive DownBeat Readers Poll Group of the Year recognition.

provenance.note: Event title, dates, all four set times and lineup verified from Keystone Korner Baltimore; ticket path verified through authorized InstantSeats; current-band identity corroborated by ARTEMIS's official site.

en.why_it_matters: The specific program is the hook: a working quintet of elite improvisers tackling Miles Davis in his centennial year, rather than a generic tribute assembled for one night. ARTEMIS has a deep collective sound, not a celebrity-collage identity, so the Miles material should be refracted through Rosnes's arranging intelligence, Jensen and Glover's front-line language, Ueda's bass and Miller's rhythmic elasticity.
en.trip_verdict: S regional. Protect one of the four sets and make the Baltimore drive; the Miles-centered program, current working-band chemistry and intimate room make this substantially more valuable than a routine tribute date.

es.why_it_matters: El gancho es el programa específico: un quinteto de trabajo formado por improvisadoras de primer nivel enfrentándose a Miles Davis en el año de su centenario, no un tributo genérico armado para una sola noche. ARTEMIS tiene un sonido colectivo profundo, no identidad de collage de celebridades, así que el material de Miles debería pasar por la inteligencia de arreglos de Rosnes, el frente Jensen-Glover, el bajo de Ueda y la elasticidad rítmica de Miller.
es.trip_verdict: S regional. Hay que proteger uno de los cuatro sets y vale manejar a Baltimore; el programa centrado en Miles, la química de una banda de trabajo y la sala íntima lo vuelven mucho más valioso que un tributo rutinario.
